purpose: Reference-only provenance for independently drawn macOS OSD recreation
distribution: Downloaded copyrighted reference images remain outside app/deliverable. No ASUS software downloaded, installed, executed, extracted, or redistributed. Small public image downloads only.

sources.evidence: The Windows 10 section explicitly associates the touchpad hotkey with the Touchpad is enabled notification. Its linked screenshot visibly shows the dark near-square OSD on an ASUS VivoBook desktop. The page names ASUS System Control Interface as a relevant driver.
sources.limit: VivoBook reference, not an FX505GT-specific capture; screenshot asset is from 2021.

sources.kind: ASUS-published primary source on Microsoft Store
sources.evidence: The rendered listing identifies publisher ASUSTeK COMPUTER INC. and says the ASUS Keyboard Hotkeys application provides Fn feature access and OSD showing the current hotkey status.
sources.limit: Does not establish the executable rendering any given state or the FX505GT factory version.

sources.evidence: ASUS distinguishes System Control Interface V2, ASUS Keyboard Hotkeys Driver (ATK Package), and legacy ATKPackage, with model-dependent use. It explicitly says hotkey drivers are integrated into System Control Interface V2 on some models.
sources.limit: Generic model-generation guidance, not a binary-level attribution of AsusOSD.exe or ASUSOptimization.

sources.evidence: The FX505GT page lists ASUS System Control Interface, Armoury Crate, MyASUS, and a Wireless radio control driver dated 2019-10-17 whose description explicitly includes airplane-mode hotkeys and OSD.
sources.limit: Live support page has updated components; it does not prove factory 2019 software versions, exact notification visuals, or that one program draws all Fn overlays.

sources.evidence: Operating Mode and Q&A describe Armoury Crate system profiles including Silent, Performance, and Turbo; profiles change CPU/GPU performance, cooling, noise and power behavior.
sources.limit: Current Ver6.0 article; establishes feature ownership, not 2019 OSD renderer executable, glyph geometry, or timing. UI varies with product/application version.

sources.kind: Firsthand owner publication; not ASUS official
sources.author: Nonames
sources.evidence: Review identifies FX505DY-BQ009 and includes photographs of keyboard-brightness and Silent-mode OSDs in corresponding software-installation sections.
sources.limit: Sibling FX505DY, not FX505GT. Camera photographs have perspective, blur, and color/scale distortion. Installation opinions are owner claims, not engineering proof.

sources.evidence: Microsoft documents its own OS hardware indicators for brightness, volume, camera and airplane mode, with a Windows 11 redesign.
sources.limit: Do not conflate Windows shell flyouts with the ASUS dark square. This article alone does not establish which specific FX505GT key invokes which renderer.

images.observed: Translucent very dark near-square panel with subtly rounded corners, large white outlined touchpad icon, one line TouchPad is enabled, no meter. Orange frame and red numbered marker are editorial annotation, not OSD.

measured_raster.origin: top-left, integer source-image pixels; approximate body edges due to antialiasing/shadow

images.measurement_method: Pillow/NumPy inspection of the downloaded original. White icon component threshold: min RGB > 210 and channel spread < 25. Panel body/shadow/corner values are edge and visual estimates, not original UI constants.
do_not_infer: intrinsic alpha or flat RGB background

images.observed: White keyboard-with-sun glyph, Korean caption 밝기 증가 (brightness increase), thin continuous bottom meter, translucent dark near-square panel with tiny rounding.
images.limit: Photograph only: no valid absolute UI-pixel measurements or transparency/color inference.

images.observed: Large white angular feather/leaf-like Silent glyph above the English word Silent; translucent dark near-square panel, tiny rounding, no meter.
images.limit: Photograph only: no valid absolute UI-pixel measurements or transparency/color inference.

direct_evidence: ASUS officially offers a hotkey-status OSD application and model-dependent hotkey driver stacks.
Armoury Crate owns gaming operating profiles such as Silent/Performance/Turbo.
ASUS official screenshot and 2020 FX505DY owner photographs corroborate the dark near-square visual family.
inference: A recreated ASUS family OSD can reasonably use dark translucent square, tiny rounding, white icon and short caption.
Profile state semantics and notification drawing should be distinguished; these pages do not identify one universal rendering process.
